final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_avg) AS country_avg FROM race_averages GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS benchmark FROM country_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.country_avg, o.benchmark FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ca.country_avg > o.benchmark), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(country_avg) AS benchmark FROM above_overall) SELECT a.country, a.country_avg, a.country_avg - a.benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark, a.country_avg - s.benchmark AS above_second_mean FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s WHERE a.country_avg > s.benchmark
